query: Which noise-robust loss functions and training procedures (label smoothing, co-teaching, uncertainty-weighting) best incorporate hierarchical confidence labels and measured inter-annotator variance?

response.query: Which noise-robust loss functions and training procedures (label smoothing, co-teaching, uncertainty-weighting) best incorporate hierarchical confidence labels and measured inter-annotator variance?
response.answer: Label smoothing and Bayesian uncertainty-weighting are effective for incorporating hierarchical confidence labels and inter-annotator variance. Co-teaching can also help with noise-robust training. These methods improve model robustness to label noise.
